apps.description:
Expense Tracker is a simple expense tracker and budget app for your everyday money. Log spending in seconds, scan receipts with your camera and see where your money goes.
No ads. No in-app purchases. No sign-up and no bank login.
Your entries are stored on your device, and everyday tracking works without an internet connection.

EXPENSE TRACKER
- See your balance, this month's income and this month's expenses on one screen.
- A last-7-days bar chart shows how each day compares.
- Add an expense or income in a few taps with a large number keypad.
- Smart notes: type "lunch 12.50" and the amount and category fill in for you.
- Six clear categories: Food & Drink, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Entertainment and Health.

RECEIPT SCANNER
- Point the camera at a receipt, or choose a photo.
- The text is read on your device. The merchant, items and total appear for you to check.
- Tap Use receipt and the merchant, total and category are filled in for the new expense.

SPENDING REPORTS
- Week, month and year views with an average line.
- See how this period compares with the one before.
- A category chart shows the share and the amount for each category.

BUDGET PLANNER
- Set a monthly budget for each category.
- A gauge shows how much of your monthly budget is used.
- Get an alert when a category goes over its limit.

SAVINGS GOALS
- Create a goal with a name and a target, and watch the progress ring fill.

BILLS
- List your bills with an amount and a due day, and mark each one paid for the month.
- The in-app notification center shows bills that are due in the next few days.

SUBSCRIPTION TRACKER
- Subscription radar finds recurring payments in the entries you have added.
- See the monthly cost, the yearly total and the next renewal date.
- It flags a price increase and can remind you the day before a renewal.

PRIVATE MONEY MANAGER
- Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.
- No account. Your entries stay on your device, or in your own iCloud if you turn on sync.
- Anonymous usage and crash statistics help us fix problems. They never include your amounts, merchant names or notes.

MORE
- Search by name, note, category or type.
- Export your transactions as a CSV file.
- Optional iCloud sync.
- Dark and light themes. The week can start on Monday, Sunday or Saturday.
- Optional daily reminder to log your spending.
- Display currency: US dollar, euro, British pound, Indian rupee or Japanese yen.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Entries are added by hand or from a receipt scan. The app does not connect to your bank.
- The app is available in 22 languages.

Track every film and show you watch.

CineBox is a movie and TV show tracker — a watchlist, a watch history and a viewing diary in one. It does not stream anything and is not tied to any streaming service. It keeps the record: what you have seen, what is next, when it lands, and what your habits actually look like.

TRACK MOVIES AND TV SHOWS
• Mark films and shows as watched in one tap
• Build a watchlist of what you want to see next
• Keep favorites for the ones worth returning to
• Everything is stored on your device — no account, no sign-up, no email

YOUR VIEWING, IN NUMBERS
• Total films and shows watched, and total hours
• Your daily watch streak
• Your top three genres
• The average TMDB score of what you watch, and your biggest month
• A running timeline you can filter by today, this week or this month

DECIDE WHAT TO WATCH NEXT
• Trending films by country and region
• Popular, now playing and airing today
• Upcoming releases with premiere dates
• Top rated films and shows
• Recommendations based on what you have actually watched

EVERY TITLE IN DEPTH
• TMDB ratings, vote counts and TMDB reviews
• Full plot summaries and taglines
• Complete cast and crew, with a page for each person
• Poster and backdrop galleries
• Similar titles worth your time
• Official trailers, opened in YouTube

NEVER MISS A RELEASE
• A reminder the day before a film you are waiting for arrives
• A release-day alert at 9 AM
• Dedicated alerts for anything on your watchlist

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
• Small — your next watchlist pick at a glance
• Medium — the top three trending films
• Large — upcoming releases with dates

SHARE WHAT YOU LOVE
• Generate a share card with poster art, rating and genres
• Send it straight from the app

SPOTLIGHT SEARCH
• Your favorites and watchlist are indexed in iOS Search
• Find anything you saved without opening the app

CINEBOX PRO
CineBox is free, and the free version is the whole app — unlimited logging, an unlimited watchlist, stats, widgets, release reminders, trailers and search all work without paying. Pro does one thing: it removes every ad. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial, and you can cancel any time in Settings.

WHY CINEBOX
• A vast, daily-updated catalog
• Fast, clean and built for iPhone
• No account required
• Your watchlist, favorites and history stay on your device
• Regular updates

FOR PEOPLE WHO WATCH A LOT
Stop losing track of what you have seen and what you meant to watch. Keep the record in CineBox, then watch wherever you already subscribe.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/cinebox-movie-discovery/terms-of-services

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/cinebox-movie-discovery/privacy-policy

apps.description:
Crick Line Guru brings you live cricket scores and the live line for international and league cricket in one clean, fast app.

Follow every ball: see the batters at the crease, the current bowlers, the current and required run rate, and the most recent balls as the match moves. When a match ends, open the full scorecard for every innings.

WHAT YOU GET
• Live cricket scores for international, franchise league, domestic and women's matches
• Live line: batters at the crease, current bowlers, CRR and RRR
• Recent balls for the over in progress
• Full scorecards: runs, balls, fours, sixes and strike rate for every batter
• Squads and playing XI
• Match info: venue, toss and start time
• Upcoming fixtures and recent results
• Series list with all matches in each series
• ICC team and player rankings for Test, ODI and T20
• Latest cricket news

FORMATS AND COMPETITIONS
Test, ODI and T20 internationals, franchise leagues, county and first-class cricket, associate-nation matches, and state T20 leagues such as the Odisha T20, Uttarakhand Premier League and Andhra Premier League.

Crick Line Guru is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ICC, any cricket board, league or team. It shows scores, statistics and news only. It does not show betting odds and does not stream video.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/crick-line-guru/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/crick-line-guru/terms-of-use

apps.description:
NOTHING TO INSTALL ON THE COMPUTER. THAT IS THE WHOLE IDEA.

ShareMe turns your iPhone into a small web page. Open the browser that is already on your Windows PC, Mac, Linux machine or tablet, type in the address ShareMe shows you, and you are looking at your phone. No software on that computer. No cable. No account. No cloud.

HOW WEB SHARE WORKS
1. Tap Web Share on the iPhone. It shows an address such as http://192.168.1.6
2. Type that address into the browser on your computer. Use http, not https.
3. The iPhone asks you to accept. Tap Accept.
4. Browse the phone's photos, videos, music and documents in the browser and download them at original size - or drag files from your desktop onto the page to send them to the iPhone.

Both directions, one page, any computer where you are allowed to open a browser. Useful on a work machine where you cannot install anything.

No Wi-Fi network in the room? Turn on Personal Hotspot, join it from the computer, and Web Share works exactly the same.

IPHONE TO IPHONE, WITH NO INTERNET AT ALL
Both phones need ShareMe. After that there is no router, no mobile data and no internet connection involved - only the Wi-Fi or Bluetooth radio being switched on. Photos, videos, music, contacts (.vcf) and documents (PDF, DOC, PPT, XLS, ZIP) move straight from one phone to the other.

- The two phones find each other on their own. No QR code, no pairing code, no sign-in.
- Received photos and videos save straight into your Photos app.
- Preview everything that arrived inside the app, and swipe to delete what you do not want.
- Cancel a transfer from either side, at any moment.

FULL SIZE. NOT A COPY OF A COPY.
Nothing is compressed and nothing is resized. A 4K video arrives as the same 4K video. Multi-gigabyte files are fine. Whole camera rolls are fine.

WHAT IS FREE AND WHAT IS NOT
iPhone-to-iPhone transfer is free and unlimited. Web Share gives you 2 free sessions; after that it needs a subscription. We are telling you here rather than after you install. The subscription is offered weekly, monthly or yearly, and the exact price in your currency is shown in the app before you buy anything. ShareMe is free to download and is supported by ads.

PRIVACY
Files travel from your device to the other device across your own local network. There is no ShareMe server in the middle, no cloud storage, no account and no sign-up. Nothing is uploaded anywhere, and nothing is kept after the transfer.

WHAT SHAREME DOES NOT DO
Better you know now than after installing:
- No iPhone to Android, and no Android to iPhone.
- No cloud storage and no online backup.
- No USB or cable transfer.
- No NAS, SMB or printing.

TIPS THAT SAVE PEOPLE TIME
- Put http:// in front of the address. Browsers assume https, and https will not connect.
- Keep the phone and the computer on the same Wi-Fi, or use Personal Hotspot.
- Keep ShareMe open on screen while a transfer is running.
- If a phone does not appear, make sure both phones have ShareMe open on the transfer screen.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of that period. You can manage or cancel a subscription in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/share-me-file-transfer/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/share-me-file-transfer/terms-of-use
